quote: This app is great but please add the option to add a merchant name.
I wish theres a way to track debts with the same UI as the savings tracker, like how much more do I owe a specific debt or interest it incurrs.
I wish this was available to androids too because I recommend it to people but if they have android they can’t use it…
I do wish I could make the calendar bigger like Zoom I , but I love the organization of this.
I wish there was some kind of benefit or prize for me in the app for referring this to other people, i’ve showed all my coworkers !

I just wish that for paychecks there were an option to say paychecks are every two weeks and set a start date and let the system determine when funds will be ready exactly , right now I leave it as 1…
I like seeing the percentage in the budget summary, but seeing the subtotals as I give each dollar its job would be nice, too.
It’s difficult to view previous months transactions, it would be nice on October 1 to be able to see Sept 30th transactions without completely switching months.
Everything works fine but I wish there was a way to transfer money within the app instead of having to make two transactions to show that you moved money from one account to another.
I would love to see them add a yearly budget within this app where I can add line items like “Christmas” or “Kids Soccer”
Even though there’s some small little details that I think would be nice to edit, all in all, this app is phenomenal.
I REALLY wish the paycheck planning feature allowed you to select the dates AND the specific amounts that will be deducted on each of those days instead of assumed it’s equally divided.

The only thing I wish they had was a notification system where one partner gets a notification on their phone whenever their partner enters a transaction and if it would give an updated remaining amo…
I love this app, and i would love it more if it would open.
One thing i wish every dollar had was the persistent notifications about categorizing like ynab because i rarely sit down and work on finances and ynab constantly reminds me.
I would love it if you all added the Ramsey tools like net worth, amortization, and interest calculators.
